ground.name: Kitchen
ground.detail: Open to the entry strip with no partition between them. The labelled kitchen area excludes EN and the enclosed puja.

ground.name: Enclosed corner puja
ground.detail: Altar on the east wall. A 2.5 ft clear timber door opens from EN through the left side wall. Enclosed room, beside PO; no entry from PO.

ground.name: Front-court entry
ground.detail: 3.5 ft clear timber entrance directly from the front court, in the former puja area. Open to kitchen and living; the left side has no partition.

ground.name: Living + west dining
ground.detail: One open family area, with dining west of the kitchen. Dining uses the inside corner of the L stair. A solid drawing-room wall carries the living-room TV; the care-room side remains glazed.

ground.name: Drawing room
ground.detail: A true 11 × 11 ft rectangle. Separate 4 ft clear timber entrance from the open porch. Solid partition to the living/kitchen side; no internal glass doorway.

ground.name: Rectangular home care
ground.detail: 12.5 × 16.5 ft = 206.25 sq ft, without an L-shaped tail. Head south, feet north. Large north garden glazing and east glazing toward parking. The care wall is 3.75 ft from the north plot boundary and over 12 ft from the west boundary.

ground.name: Ground master
ground.detail: 14 × 13.5 ft = 189 sq ft, with normal-size furniture, a 3.5 ft clear entry and a separate attached bathroom. Rear light strip retained behind this bedroom.

ground.name: Master bath
ground.detail: 5.5 × 7 ft attached bath; 3 ft clear timber pocket door from the master. Fixture arrangement is indicative.

ground.name: Caregiver
ground.detail: 45 sq ft; 7.5 × 6 ft. Single 3 × 6.5 ft bed and minimal storage, directly off the veranda along the west edge. Compact sleeping accommodation; local habitable-room requirements remain to be checked.

ground.name: Caregiver WC
ground.detail: 5 × 6 ft, attached to the caregiver room. Timber pocket door, not a glass panel.

ground.name: Rear veranda
ground.detail: 5 ft main depth between care and caregiver, with a 3.5 ft return behind the family hall. Independent timber doors from care and family hall; caregiver access does not require crossing the care room.

ground.name: L stair + lower landing
ground.detail: 3.5 ft wide flights: climb west, turn north. 84 sq ft occupied including the lower approach landing; 12 × 15.5 ft bounding box includes the dining corner. 20 proposed rises of 182.9 mm, 287.9 mm treads. The same flights stack to the roof; headroom and structure require design coordination.

ground.name: North garden path
ground.detail: 3 ft unobstructed walking strip. Wall-trained greenery, with pots in the wider northwest corner rather than in the route.

ground.name: Northwest garden
ground.detail: Together with the north strip, a 5 × 6.5 ft northwest garden pocket stays unbuilt. Caregiver and WC occupy the west strip further south.

ground.name: Rear light strip
ground.detail: 2 ft rear light/maintenance strip behind the ground master. Not labelled as an accessible route.

ground.name: South daylight lane
ground.detail: 3.5 ft clear lane ends at the glazed stair landing. The final landing is inside the house so the west-climbing flight can be entered from the open kitchen/hall.

ground.name: Drawing porch
ground.detail: 11 × 4 ft, open to the sky. Its only room entrance is the separate drawing-room timber door.

ground.name: Front court
ground.detail: Uniform 4 ft allocated depth across the pedestrian frontage, measured from the inside of the front boundary to the aligned building/PO line. The two 150 mm entry steps occupy the first 2 ft locally, leaving 2 ft of raised court before the continuous 4 ft-deep PO. No extra step between court and PO. Parking stays separate at the lower level.

ground.name: Car bay
ground.detail: 10.5 × 19 ft. A 6.5 × 15.5 ft reference car leaves 2 ft side margins and 1.75 ft at each end. Final gate and swept approach depend on the actual vehicle.

first.name: Front master suite
first.detail: 203.5 sq ft sleeping/seating space: 17 × 11 ft main rectangle plus the east bay. Over drawing, puja and part of kitchen/entry; separate bath/dress over the remaining kitchen. Timber doors to the family lounge and terrace.

first.name: Bath + dressing
first.detail: 6.5 × 10.5 ft, combining bathroom and dressing/storage. 3 ft clear timber pocket door from the front master.

first.name: Rear master suite
first.detail: 18 × 13 ft = 234 sq ft, mostly over the southwest master and rear service area. A true rectangular sleeping room with a king bed, wardrobe and seating; separate attached bathroom.

first.name: Rear ensuite
first.detail: 6 × 7 ft attached bathroom with a 3 ft clear timber pocket door. Wet services can align broadly with the ground bath/service zone.

first.name: Small office
first.detail: 8.5 × 6.5 ft = 55.25 sq ft, over the caregiver/service strip. Independent 3.5 ft clear timber entry from the common hall; the northwest garden corner remains outside the room.

first.name: Upper family lounge + circulation
first.detail: A furnished 12 × 8.5 ft main lounge bay plus the stair approach and room connections. Rear passage is 4 ft clear, widening to a 6 ft terrace/office lobby. These circulation areas are included in the displayed total, not counted as one rectangular lounge.

first.name: Double-height living opening
first.detail: 6 × 6 ft = 36 sq ft open to the ground living room, reduced from about 55 sq ft. Retain the approximately 23 ft clear height and a rooflight. Guard the upper edges; no floor or bedroom crosses this opening.

first.name: Garden terrace
first.detail: 241 sq ft, mostly over the rectangular care room, with a 10 × 5 ft return over the rear portion of parking. Timber doors from both the common lounge and front master. Edge planting and a small pergola seating zone leave the middle open. Parking extension needs structural design, drainage and headroom confirmation.

first.name: L stair: first floor to roof
first.detail: Repeat the west-then-north L flight above the ground stair. The first-floor approach wraps around the east end to reach the next flight. Proposed roof arrival: 5 × 4 ft landing, enclosed stair head and a 3.5 ft clear timber exit. Roof terrace is one storey above the care-room terrace.
